items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This trombone player I was trying to remember a while back, his name was Archie Hall... Yeah, Archie Hall. You can read about him in the Black Almanac... he was one of the fine trombone players of that time.

ctx.x: Were there any guys in the Basie band who particularly were hit harder than others with these horrible experiences?

Some of them…when you were born in the South, you know what to expect. Born in the North, naturally you’ll go down there and do something stupid not even knowing that you’re wrong, ‘cause who’s who to say who’s right and who’s wrong. Who are they to say you can’t go in this place, you can’t do this, you got two bathrooms to go to, if you go to the white bathroom you get clubbed by the police. That’s so stupid. But there were a few musicians…Lucky Millinder got beat up down there one time. Policeman just really…he…
